name: Knotlog
description: Persistent session memory for coding agents, kept as plain Markdown notes in a local folder (the vault). Search the vault, read its byte-budgeted session context, and add one line to today's session note (the file is rewritten through a temporary copy). The server makes no network calls; what it returns goes to the MCP client, which may send it to its model provider. Off until you turn it on.
saferAlternatives: knotlog_search and knotlog_context never change notes but may write state files under .knotlog/. ctx_max (default 4096) sizes output but is not a hard cap: pinned context is never cut, and an inherited KNOTLOG_CTX_MAX overrides it.
knotlog_note is the only tool that changes notes: it adds one line by writing a temporary copy and renaming it over today's session note, so file permissions follow the umask. It stays on review.
Notes matching a secret pattern (AWS, GitHub, Slack, Google keys, private keys) are refused before anything is written.
Set write_approval=on in .knotlog/config to queue notes for review with knotlog pending instead of writing them.
Set KNOTLOG_VAULT in the server's env config to pin the vault. Without it the vault comes from an inherited KNOTLOG_VAULT or QUIPU_VAULT, then the working directory.
